verdicts.evidence: s1 uses INIT_CWD to construct the package.json path passed to require inside the try; a thrown load returns from validation in s2.
The try must successfully load the package.json reached through INIT_CWD; its catch returns before fallback installation, giving the file probe positive existence polarity.
s1 reads the package-manager environment variable INIT_CWD to locate the initiating package, fitting package_manager.
The name destructured from the initiating package.json at f1:69 is compared against two package names at s3.
s4 returns when either listed package name matches, so continuing to fallback requires name to be outside that pair.
The comparison reads the consuming package name loaded from its package.json, fitting consuming_app.
s5 assigns the result of require to binding, which is tested by the early return in s6.
Failure to load binding.js leaves binding unset and permits continuation; a truthy binding returns at s6 even if subsequent validation threw.
Loading binding.js resolves the available native or WASI dependency through f2, making dependency_tree an appropriate category.
s7 directly reads SWC_BINARY_PATH in the double-negated condition of the early return at s8.
s8 returns for a truthy SWC_BINARY_PATH, so reaching fallback installation requires a falsy value.
s7 directly tests an environment variable used to configure a manual binary override, fitting env_var.
s9 binds require.resolve output to wasmBinding, and s10 tests that same binding for truthiness and filesystem existence.
s11 returns only when resolution produced a truthy wasmBinding whose file exists; fallback continues when the resolved dependency is absent or its path is missing.
s9 and s10 check whether the wasm dependency resolves to an existing file, fitting dependency_tree.
s12 begins at f1:105, before the c5 decision at f1:110, so that entire region is not controlled by the conjunction including c5; its dependency resolution runs before c5 is decided.
The early returns at f1:70, f1:96, f1:100 and f1:110 decide whether the npm fallback installation and its file operations run, fitting enables.
The checks permit fallback installation when a usable dependency is unavailable and no manual override is set; they do not inspect analysis or sandbox indicators, fitting activate.
Native binding loading is selected by platform, architecture and libc, and postinstall supplies a wasm fallback when binding loading fails, fitting portability.

The s12 region starts with wasmBinding declaration and resolution at f1:105, before the s11 early exit; therefore the c5 guard does not control the entire claimed region, although the cited sinks occur after it.
